implementation_summary: Added the preview barrel export to the audit barrel and added the preview entry points (generatePreview, sanitizePreviewHtml) plus the preview group to the audit exports contract test. packages/core/src/index.ts already carried the audit export line, so it was not changed.

tests_executed.name: audit exports reach @qa/core (20 tests)
tests_executed.command: CI=1 pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/tests/audit-exports.test.ts

risks: Barrel now re-exports the preview group, so any future name clash in preview/index.ts surfaces as a TS2308 build error; the build passed for the current names.
The reachability test checks that the names are defined on @qa/core, not that they behave correctly.
handoff: BE-189 is complete with the preview group included. Downstream code can import generatePreview, sanitizePreviewHtml and the other preview names from @qa/core. No dependency on the preview module needs a separate import path.
